kultivator.screen.help.kehancuran_diri.t: Destruction Mode for your own techniques (OFF by default)
kultivator.screen.help.kehancuran_diri: WARNING: with this switch on, your own techniques really destroy world blocks. It is OFF by default and takes one click to turn on or off (the red seal on the Destruction page of the Technique Codex, or /kultivasi kehancuran nyala and mati; /kultivasi kehancuran semua nyala switches on everything at once, including Total Destruction, Molten Crater and the Titah decrees). Techniques carve only from Golden Core. Hold Shift when you cast to keep that cast block-safe. Never touched: 4 blocks around you (full height), 24 blocks around beds and other players, 64 around Sect Halls, and the ground near villagers, pets and disciples. Undo with /kultivasi kehancuran pulihkan within 10 minutes; the undo is lost when the server restarts.
